sources.name: Skiper UI
sources.license: Selected free components permit personal/commercial use and modification with attribution; Pro components have separate terms.
sources.bestFor: Compact micro-interactions, expanding galleries and spatial motion
sources.caveat: Actual free Skiper41/52/106 components, attributed in every demo. No Pro code. Compact layout, original artwork, keyboard/touch controls and fixed caret defaults are documented.

sources.name: Amicro
sources.license: MIT (2026 SYED SUBHAN UDDIN); retained in AMICRO_LICENSE.txt.
sources.bestFor: Tactile card spreads, morphing controls and spring-based micro-interactions
sources.caveat: Actual CardScatterSpread pinned to dc2a183, with original artwork and a keyboard/touch toggle.
sources.install: Copy the selected MIT component from the repository

sources.name: Spline
sources.license: Hosted platform and scene-specific rights; an embed does not grant an asset reuse license.
sources.bestFor: Interactive 3D objects, material studies, physical interactions and product scenes
sources.caveat: Reviewed the official library and Mini Home template. No local Spline scene is included: the runtime and scene loading were too heavy for this atlas. Retained as a tool reference; use your own exported scene and measure loading/GPU cost.
sources.install: npm install @splinetool/runtime, then load your exported scene URL

demos.title: Expanding strips
demos.summary: Artwork strips expand around the selected image.
demos.watch: Actual Skiper52 renderer with compact dimensions and focusable buttons. Hover, focus or tap; original Atlas artwork.

demos.title: Progressive blur
demos.summary: Artwork softens at the edges of a scrolling window.
demos.use: Scroll surfaces, floating headers and contained collections
demos.watch: Actual Skiper41 ProgressiveBlur with original artwork. Scroll the inner window; compare with the blur toggle. Backdrop filter needs browser support.

demos.title: Smooth caret
demos.summary: Compare a spring-driven text cursor with the native caret.
demos.use: Experimental inputs and expressive creative tools
demos.watch: Actual Skiper106 SmoothInput with fixed default tuning values. Type, select and use arrow keys. Upstream labels this an experiment, not an accessibility-critical production control.

demos.title: Card fan
demos.summary: A stack of artwork deals into a spring-driven fan.
demos.use: Collection previews and compact visual navigation
demos.watch: Actual Amicro CardScatterSpread, controlled by a keyboard/touch button. Original Atlas artwork. Starts spread so the gallery illustrates the effect immediately.

demos.title: Clip path reveal
demos.summary: A circular mask opens one scene into another.
demos.use: Image reveals, section changes and page transitions
demos.watch: Original GSAP study, not an Amicro or Skiper component. Replay, scrub or click the scene to move the reveal origin. Reduced motion changes scenes instantly.

demos.title: Zoom through
demos.summary: Push through an opening into the next scene.
demos.watch: Original GSAP portal composition with a masked SVG foreground and layered scale. Replay or scrub the progress slider. Reduced motion changes scenes instantly.
